notes.title: Demo Update | Checkout Conveyor & Controller Support
notes.content:
Main New Features:


 Checkout conveyor products: Products will now spawn on the checkout conveyor belt. The player has to interact with each product to scan them. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171888/599f526a241ea95cec2297cf11ee128c8e31258b.png"]
Bug Fixes: 
Price tags now show the selling price instead of the buying price 

Price tags now update correctly when changing the price





[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912750/Storefront_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]



Do not forget to wishlist our full game! Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Demo Update | Price tags and Employee Upgrades
notes.content:
Main New Features:

Reworked Warehouse Menu: Products are now neatly organized into intuitive submenus, significantly reducing clutter and enhancing overview.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171888/10d766824dc38524297d045ac4896a66dac3c1a2.png

Improved Restocker Employee Behavior: Restockers now perform their duties more efficiently, ensuring smoother warehouse operations.

New Price Tags on Warehouse Racks: Clearly visible price tags have been added directly onto racks, improving clarity and accessibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171888/eb7846f323297e6d9121ad111518fc247586689b.png

Interactive Shelf Price Tags: Shelves now feature interactive price tags, allowing quick addition and removal of products.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171888/09c037301091aafaadc25a0285af1e536816e509.png

Employee Upgrades System: Boost your employees' productivity with upgrades available for work speed and walking speed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171888/f3199c013a79cea05d5fdf8f6474da638ff2723d.png

Bug Fixes:


Fixed memory leak issue related to janitor activities.
Pillars can now be removed as intended.
Several translation errors have been corrected, enhancing overall game accessibility.
Several small issues have been resolved.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912750/Storefront_Simulator/

Do not forget to wishlist our full game!
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the update!
